contract_risk_if_only_two_physical_proof: Without a converged ACTIVE record, an abort may observe NONE or a torn C2J after mutations have started.
Without a converged CLEAR record, a late zero may leave ACTIVE visible after return or erase the ACTIVE record of the following transaction.
Post-header export-journal and symbol-function writes need the successful CLEAR bookend as their ordered tail fence.
Rollback restoration writes need the rollback CLEAR bookend as their ordered tail fence.

class_c_question.question: Does 'completion proof at exactly two points' mean exactly two amortized transaction-data barriers, while C2J ACTIVE and C2J CLEAR remain mandatory independently content-converged journal bookends?
class_c_question.consequence_of_yes: Rewrite the draft contract around two gathered data boundaries plus two journal bookends, then deduplicate into one common cold body before any slice split or WPLTO.
class_c_question.consequence_of_no: If only two physical proofs total are allowed, the existing every-error rollback and publish-last journal contract is under-specified and product work must remain stopped.
